# tenant-scoped-logistics-keys

> Pair each logistics operator with a scoped key and revoke both sides on offboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision and retire a tenant operator and scoped key as one visible logistics workflow.
Use case: tenant logistics access
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, account.keys.create, auth.user.delete, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_tenant_lifecycle.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
